# AGENTS.md

How agents work in this repository. The rules are in [ai/RULES.md](ai/RULES.md) and win over
anything here; this file is the operational summary.

## What this is

droid-observatory: a Tauri 2 + Leptos (Rust) desktop app that shows a Factory Mission moving
through nine lanes, with validation, gate, agent attribution, waste and cost per sub-droid.
PRD: `ai/prd/droid-observatory-prd.md`. Spec: `SPEC.md` (approved 2026-10-22; the mission plans from it).

Current state: no application code. The walking skeleton (core crate, canonical `Event`,
`observatory replay` over one captured session, an empty board that starts) is the first
thing the mission lands, before any milestone deepens its area.

## Setup, build, test

```sh
make doctor          # tool check with install hints
make hooks           # enable .githooks (once)
make check           # all light checks = mission-branch CI
make fmt             # rustfmt (no-op until Cargo.toml exists)
make lint            # clippy -D warnings
make test            # cargo test --workspace
make deny            # cargo-deny advisories, licences, bans
make replay-fixtures # observatory-cli replay over fixtures/streams/*.jsonl
make app-dev         # Tauri dev window (after the app exists)
```

Toolchain: `rust-toolchain.toml` (1.99.1, rustfmt, clippy, wasm32 target). Do not change it
without a decision file.

## Runtime limits (measured)

Measured 2026-10-22 on the owner's machine; source `reports/readiness/2026-10-22-validation-readiness.md`
(SPEC §5.8):

- At most 3 concurrent agent-browser validator sessions per `trunk serve` (1.34-1.54 GB RSS each,
  CPU negligible idle); use `--session <name>` per validator.
- `cargo llvm-cov` runs alone (1-min load 3.3 → 14.6 on 10 cores during the scratch run).
- All cargo builds serialize on the shared `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` lock
  (`Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory`); expect waits, not failures.
- `trunk serve` and `cargo tauri dev` coexist only when exactly one trunk owns port 3141
  (`cargo tauri dev` starts its own); killing `cargo-tauri` alone orphans trunk and the app binary.
- Cold `trunk serve` 55.94 s, incremental 1.46-2.08 s, `cargo tauri dev` to running app 37.66 s.
- The Tauri window has no CDP endpoint; validators use the smoke check (process alive, `Running`
  log line, WebKit connections on 3141, System Events listing) plus the browser path on 3141.

## Interactive QA path

Until the app exists: `make check` is the only runnable target.
Once the skeleton lands, the path the validators follow is:

1. `make doctor` reports no missing required tools.
2. `cargo run -p observatory-cli -- replay fixtures/streams/<capture>.jsonl` prints lane
   events and ends with `unknown events: 0`.
3. `make app-dev` opens the window; open the same fixture (Replay); the nine lanes render
   and a card opens its Details view.
4. With the window open, start `droid exec --mission ...` in a terminal; the new session
   appears on the board (Attach) and each event shows within 1 s.

No login gate: the app watches and reads local session files and uses the GitHub token from the keychain or
`GITHUB_TOKEN` only for the gate lane.

## Layout and ownership

```text
crates/observatory-core   ingest, model, metrics, store, control (no UI deps)
crates/observatory-cli    headless replay/inspect over core
apps/observatory-app      Tauri 2 shell + Leptos UI
fixtures/streams          captured mission streams, named <YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.jsonl
docs/decisions            D-NNN-slug.md, one per decision; README.md is generated
docs/runbooks             recovery procedures: red gate, fix cycle, stall, hooks, release
reports/                  usage, waste, readiness; pasted from tools
build-log/                tool-call log written by .factory hooks
ai/                       PRD, rules, template, session logs
```

Crate and app paths are the contract the Makefile and CI probe for; keep them.

## Conventions

- Rust 2024 edition, `rustfmt.toml` and `clippy.toml` as committed. Warnings are errors.
- Naming: standard Rust (`snake_case` items and modules, `CamelCase` types, `SCREAMING_SNAKE`
  consts). Event kinds mirror the PRD §7 names in `snake_case`
  (`finding.blocking` → `FindingBlocking`). Lane and role enums use the PRD's words.
- Tests: unit tests in `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` next to the code; integration tests in
  `crates/<crate>/tests/<topic>.rs`; fixture-driven tests read `fixtures/streams/`. Test
  functions read as sentences: `rework_window_closes_on_resolution()`.
- Tests before code (rule 1): commit the red test, then the code that turns it green.
- No magic numbers: every threshold lives in `config/observatory.example.toml` with a reason.
- Debt markers: `TODO(#123)` or `TODO(B-123)`; anything else fails `make check-todos`.
- Markdown: `.markdownlint-cli2.yaml`; links must resolve (`make check-links`).
- Files over 200 KB fail CI unless under `fixtures/streams/` or `build-log/`.

## Git

- Forward only (rule 12): never amend, reset, rebase, stash, or force-push. Fix with a new
  commit. `.factory/hooks/guard-git.sh` and `.githooks/pre-push` enforce this.
- Nothing reaches `main` except the mission's single pull request. `main` has a ruleset:
  PR required, `gate` check required, no force push, no bypass.
- Milestones live in worktrees and integrate into `mission/<name>`. Two worktrees never edit
  the same file (rule 13); shared files (`SPEC.md` §9–10, `README.md`, `BACKLOG.md`,
  `docs/decisions/README.md`) are written by the orchestrator at integration time.
- Commit subject under 72 characters; co-author trailer for agent commits:
  `Co-authored-by: factory-droid[bot] <138933559+factory-droid[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>`.

## Decisions, backlog, logs

- A decision is one file: `docs/decisions/D-NNN-slug.md` with `**Date:**`, `**Status:**`,
  context, decision, alternatives, consequences. Run `make decisions-index` after adding one.
- Deferred work goes to `BACKLOG.md` as `B-NNN` with a reason, not into TODOs or GitHub issues
  (rule 14; owner decision 2026-10-22 at mission approval).
- Every session is logged under `ai/session/` with transcript links; every tool call is
  logged to `build-log/` by the PostToolUse hook. Do not disable the hooks.
- Usage and waste per milestone go to `reports/` pasted from the tool that produced them.

## Mission setup

Models per role (rule 19; `.factory/settings.json`; D-006):

| Role | Model |
|---|---|
| Orchestrator | `claude-fable-5.1` |
| Workers | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |
| Validators (scrutiny, user testing) | `claude-opus-5-5` |

Command: see README "Running it as a mission".
Reasoning effort: orchestrator `high`, workers `high`, validators `high` (SPEC §2).
A model change is a decision file.

The human answers only at milestone boundaries or when the stall flag is up (rule 15).
Deviations from the spec are proposed with reason and cost, and wait for approval (rule 9).

## Environment and secrets

See `.env.example`. Secrets come from the OS keychain (`droid-observatory/<name>` entries)
or the environment, never from the repository, the store, or logs. Raw session JSONL may
contain secrets: render read-only, never upload, never copy into the store.

- The GitHub token is a read-only fine-grained PAT; read check results via Actions runs
  (`/repos/{o}/{r}/actions/runs`) and commit statuses (`/repos/{o}/{r}/commits/{sha}/status`), not the
  Checks API (no Checks permission). Keychain items are generic passwords with service
  `droid-observatory/<name>` (see `reports/readiness/2026-10-22-dependency-readiness.md`).

Grafana Cloud OTLP (`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*`) is the telemetry backend; export is off unless
`[telemetry].enabled = true`.

## Do not

- Add a dependency without `make deny` passing and a version verified on the day (rule 3).
- Write to `main`, rewrite history, or touch another worktree's files.
- Estimate a count, timing or token number: paste it from the tool (rule 7).
- Drop an unknown event: count it and show it (rule 18).
</coding_guidelines>

You are a worker in a multi-agent mission. This skill defines the procedures that ALL workers must follow. After completing startup, you'll invoke your specific worker skill for the actual work procedure.

**Using the manifest:**
- Read it to find commands/services

- For commands: use named commands (e.g., `commands.test`)

# droid-observatory architecture

Authoritative design for the mission `observatory-v1`. Written for implementation workers (Rust,
Leptos, Tauri, CI) who will not read the PRD. Sources, in precedence order: `planning-notes.md`
(owner decisions after the spec, binding), `SPEC.md` v0.2, `ai/prd/droid-observatory-prd.md` v0.6,
`docs/decisions/D-*`, the two readiness reports of 2026-10-22, `config/observatory.example.toml`.
Where the sources leave a choice, the choice here is marked `[arch decision]` with its reason.
Paths are relative to the repository root unless absolute. Numbers are pasted from the readiness
reports; none are estimated.

## 1. System overview and invariants

A Factory Mission writes one JSONL per agent session under `~/.factory/sessions/<cwd-slug>/`.
`observatory-core` turns those lines (and, later, a hosted JSON-RPC stream, local git and GitHub)
into canonical `Event`s on nine lanes, indexes them in SQLite by pointer, computes views and
metrics; `observatory-cli` exercises core headlessly; `observatory-app` (Tauri 2 shell + Leptos
CSR UI) renders the board. Attach (watch + tail) is the primary live mode; replay is attach at
end of file; host is the secondary path and the only one with a control channel (D-008).

Invariants every worker must keep (a violation is a blocking finding):

| # | Invariant | Where enforced |
|---|---|---|
| I1 | `observatory-core` is synchronous: no `tokio`, no `async fn` in its public API. tokio lives only in `apps/observatory-app/src-tauri`. | `cargo machete` + review; `Cargo.toml` of core has no async runtime |
| I2 | The UI holds no logic: card position, filters, scrubbing, tray count, details data, library entries are functions in `core::view`, unit-tested there. The Leptos crate only renders what the shell sends. | SPEC §6 "UI logic" |
| I3 | Raw lines are read-only and never copied into the store. The store keeps `path, byte_offset, byte_len`; the line is re-read on demand. `~/.factory/sessions/` is never written. | `store` DDL has no payload column; `JsonlSource` opens files read-only |
| I4 | Every `Event` carries `mapping_version` and a `SourcePtr`. | type system; test `every_event_carries_the_mapping_version()` |
| I5 | Unknown raw lines become `EventKind::Unknown { raw_type }`, are counted and shown (tray, CLI final line `unknown events: N`, exported counter), never dropped. | `mapping::map_record` is total: it always returns at least one `Event` |
| I6 | Thresholds and intervals come only from `Config` (`config/observatory.example.toml` is the contract); no literal in code. | `clippy.toml`; review |
| I7 | Secrets come only from the keychain (`droid-observatory/<name>`, account = login user) or, for the GitHub token only, `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Never in config, store, logs, telemetry, test fixtures. The `tracing` layer redacts (§12). | `secrets` module is the only reader |
| I8 | The one outward write is the merge (FR-G5), human-confirmed, named PR and target, logged as a lane-7 event. The app never merges on its own; `policy-merged` is observed, not performed. | `control::merge` is the only caller of `Forge::merge` |
| I9 | Core modules that the UI compiles to wasm (`model`, `mapping`, `view`, `metrics`, `config`) have no platform dependency; platform modules sit behind Cargo features (§2). | `trunk build` of the UI crate |

## 2. Workspace layout

```text
Cargo.toml                       workspace, resolver = "3", [workspace.package] version, edition = "2024"
Cargo.lock                       committed (S)
crates/observatory-core/         lib, package `observatory-core`
  src/lib.rs
  src/model/        {mod.rs, event.rs, ids.rs, lane.rs, role.rs, kind.rs, usage.rs}
  src/ingest/       {mod.rs, source.rs, jsonl.rs, sidecar.rs, capture.rs, watch.rs (M1, feature `watch`),
                     rpc.rs (M2, feature `rpc`), git.rs (M4), github.rs (M4, feature `github`), forge.rs (M4)}
  src/mapping/      {mod.rs, version.rs, v1/{mod.rs, kinds.rs, roles.rs, ids.rs}}
  src/store/        {mod.rs, schema.rs, migrations/0001_init.sql ... } (feature `store`)
  src/metrics/      {mod.rs, time_state.rs, rework.rs, overhead.rs, derived.rs, cost.rs, export.rs, oracle.rs} (M5)
  src/view/         {mod.rs, board.rs, filter.rs, scrubber.rs, details.rs, agents.rs, library.rs, scrub.rs} (M1)
  src/control/      {mod.rs, action.rs, stall.rs, merge.rs} (M3; merge.rs M4)
  src/config.rs     Config + defaults = the example file
  src/secrets.rs    keychain + env lookup (feature `secrets`)
  src/telemetry.rs  series plan, label allow-list, budget, header parsing (pure; exporter in the app)
  tests/            replay_s.rs (S), mapping.rs (M0), store.rs (M0), attach_latency.rs (M1), view.rs (M1),
                    rpc.rs (M2), control.rs (M3), forge.rs (M4), oracle.rs (M5), telemetry.rs (M5)
crates/observatory-cli/          bin `observatory-cli`; src/main.rs, src/{replay,inspect,metrics}.rs; tests/cli.rs
apps/observatory-app/
```

|---|---|

| M1 | `view::*` incl. `scrub` (B-006), `ingest::watch`, Tauri commands `open_replay`, `list_sessions`, `attach`, `event_raw`, `library`; UI board, Details Timeline, agent panel, tray, filters, scrubber, library |
| M2 | `ingest::rpc`, app `host.rs` (spawn, stdin writes, reaping), launch screen, commands `host_launch`, `host_control` |
| M3 | `control::{action, stall}`, runbook mapping, commands `human_action`, event `stall_flag` |
| M4 | `ingest::{git, github, forge}`, `control::merge`, commands `gate`, `merge`, event `gate_changed`, `demo-gate.yml`, `demo/base` |
| M5 | `metrics::*`, `telemetry` (core) + `src-tauri/telemetry.rs` (exporter), CLI `metrics --csv`, commands `metrics`, `export`, `telemetry_status`, lane 9 panel, Details tabs Cost/Review/Criteria/Commits/Gate |

## 3. Canonical event model (`core::model`)

```rust
// model/ids.rs  — newtypes, serde transparent, Display = inner string
pub struct EventId(pub String);     // "<session_id>:<byte_offset>:<sub>"  [arch decision] deterministic from the pointer,
                                    // no hash dependency; <sub> is the 0-based index when one raw line yields several events
pub struct SessionId(pub String);   // Droid session uuid (file stem)
pub struct MissionId(pub String);   // = SessionId of the root session (no callingSessionId) [arch decision]: the only id
                                    // present before M0 confirms where --tag lives; the display name prefers the tag
pub struct MilestoneId(pub String); // opaque; assigned by mapping::v1::ids (M0), e.g. "m0"
pub struct FeatureId(pub String);   // opaque; assigned by mapping::v1::ids (M0)
pub struct ModelId(pub String);     // e.g. "claude-sonnet-5-5"
pub struct Timestamp(pub time::OffsetDateTime); // RFC 3339 on the wire, UTC
```

```rust
// model/event.rs — PRD appendix A plus the two SPEC §5.2 additions (source byte_len, mapping_version)
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Event {
    pub id: EventId,
    pub mission_id: MissionId,
    pub milestone_id: Option<MilestoneId>,
    pub feature_id: Option<FeatureId>,
    pub lane: Lane,                      // never Lane::TimeWasteCost (computed lane); debug_assert in constructors
    pub kind: EventKind,
    pub role: Role,
    pub session_id: Option<SessionId>,
    pub model: Option<ModelId>,
    pub at: Timestamp,
    pub duration: Option<std::time::Duration>,   // serde as integer milliseconds `duration_ms`
    pub usage: Option<TokenUsage>,
    pub source: SourcePtr,
    pub mapping_version: MappingVersion,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "source", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SourcePtr {
    Jsonl  { path: PathBuf, byte_offset: u64, byte_len: u32 },
    Rpc    { path: PathBuf, byte_offset: u64, byte_len: u32 }, // host spool file, §4.5 [arch decision]
    Git    { repo: PathBuf, sha: String },
    GitHub { url: String },                                      // API URL of the object observed
    App    { action_id: u64 },                                   // lane-7 action row id (human_actions.id)
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub struct TokenUsage { pub input: u64, pub output: u64, pub cache_read: u64, pub cache_write: u64,
                        pub credits: Option<f64> }   // credits = settings `factoryCredits` when present (PRD §10.5)
```

```rust
// model/lane.rs — nine, PRD §7 order. Lane::ALL is the board order; number() is 1-based.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Lane { Intent, Orchestrator, Workers, Scrutiny, UserTesting, Integration, Human, Outside, TimeWasteCost }
impl Lane {
    pub const ALL: [Lane; 9];
    pub fn number(self) -> u8;                // 1..=9
    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str;        // "Intent", "Orchestrator", "Workers", "Validators, scrutiny",
                                              // "Validators, user testing", "Integration", "Human", "Outside",
                                              // "Time, Waste, Cost and models"
    pub fn for_role(role: Role) -> Lane;      // Orchestrator→2, Worker→3, ScrutinyValidator→4, UserTestingValidator→5,
                                              // Human→7, External→8, Unresolved→3  (lane of an Unknown event)
}
// model/role.rs
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Role { Orchestrator, Worker, ScrutinyValidator, UserTestingValidator, Human, External,
                Unresolved }   // [arch decision] a child session whose role cannot be resolved stays visible
                               // with its own count instead of being guessed (rule 18 spirit); PRD has the first six
```

`EventKind` (`model/kind.rs`): one unit variant per PRD §7 name in CamelCase (`intent.created` →
`IntentCreated`, `qa.scenario.passed` → `QaScenarioPassed`, `gate_command.run` → `GateCommandRun`,

### 4.1 Source trait and RawRecord

```rust
pub struct RawRecord { pub ptr: SourcePtr, pub session_id: SessionId, pub bytes: Vec<u8> /* one line, no newline */ }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SourceKind { Jsonl, Rpc, Git, GitHub }

pub trait Source {
    fn kind(&self) -> SourceKind;
    /// Pull the next records. Returns an empty Vec when nothing new is available right now.
    /// Never blocks longer than one poll interval; never returns an error for "no data".
    fn next_batch(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<RawRecord>, IngestError>;
    /// True when every known file has been read to its current end (replay = attach that reached EOF, D-008).
    fn at_eof(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`[arch decision]` `next_batch` + `at_eof` replace SPEC §5.4's `poll`: the name says it pulls, and
`at_eof` is what makes replay and attach one code path (the CLI stops at `at_eof()`, the watcher keeps
calling). `IngestError` (thiserror): `Io { path, source }`, `FileMoved { path }`, `TooLarge { path, mb }`.

Design: `notify` 8.2.0 (FSEvents) for create/modify; a poll every `jsonl_poll_ms` (500) re-stats every
watched file and lists the directory, because FSEvents coalesces and a file created before start would be
missed (PRD §14). Startup scan attaches files modified in the last 24 h as growing [arch decision: a
bound so a directory with hundreds of old sessions does not open them all; older files stay in the
library and open on demand]. At most `max_watched_sessions` (64) files are tailed, newest first; the
UI shows "N sessions not watched". Growth is read by `JsonlSource::next_batch` in one `tail_chunk_kb`
step per poll. Everything runs on one `std::thread` owned by the shell (`backend.rs`), which batches
events toward the UI every `event_batch_ms` (100).

### 4.5 RpcSource (M2, feature `rpc`)

The shell spawns `droid exec --mission --input-format stream-jsonrpc --output-format stream-jsonrpc
<flags from the launch screen> -f <mission file>` with `tokio::process` (stdin piped, stdout piped,
stderr to a log). Every stdout line is appended verbatim to the spool
`~/.droid-observatory/hosted/<launch-id>.jsonl` `[arch decision]`: a hosted stream exists nowhere else,
`inspect`/Details need a raw line, and the spool is the raw source for `SourcePtr::Rpc` (it is not a
copy of a Droid file). `RpcSource` is a `JsonlSource` over the spool (same tail code, I3 holds).
Control writes go to stdin as JSON-RPC 2.0 requests:

Seven milestones on the board of the build: the walking skeleton `S` first (rule 2), then
`M0`–`M5` in PRD §13 order. PRD §13 counts six; the seventh is the skeleton rule 2 requires, so
the PRD count is superseded here (rule 8). A milestone is integrated into the mission branch, never
shipped. The spec itself is not a milestone: it is approved before the mission starts.

**B-010 settled: skeleton before M0, and the capture is this mission.** Rule 2 wants the thinnest
end-to-end slice first; PRD §13 wants M0 to freeze the mapping before M1–M5 are planned in detail.
Both hold because the capture needs no extra mission: the moment the owner runs the §2 command, the
orchestrator's session JSONL is growing under `~/.factory/sessions/`, and the skeleton's workers
and validators add child sessions for every role. `S` replays a snapshot of that file through a
mapper that knows nothing yet (every line is `unknown.event`, counted). `M0` snapshots the same
sessions again at `S` integration, now with all four roles present, freezes it as the fixture,
and drives the unknown count to zero. The optional B-009 pre-capture is not needed; a small
sample-repo mission (PRD §13 M0) is the fallback only if role identification cannot be established
from this mission's own files.

**Common to every milestone.**

- Tests first (rule 1): each feature begins with a red test committed in the worktree; the
  scrutiny validator checks that the red run exists in the worker's log.
- Acceptance commands are the ones in §6 and `make check`; counts are pasted, not estimated.
- Exit needs: `make check` green on the mission branch after integration, `mission-checks` green
  on the push, zero blocking findings open, §9/§10 rows written, README/BACKLOG/decisions index
  updated (rule 16), `reports/usage/<m>.md` and `reports/readiness/<date>-<m>.json` added
  (B-015), and no `unknown.event` on the capture if the milestone adds a source (rule 18).
- Must not touch: `main`, another milestone's worktree, `rust-toolchain.toml` without a decision,
  the shared files (§2), the ruleset on `main`.
- Fixtures: `fixtures/streams/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.jsonl` is the orchestrator session; its child
  sessions live in `fixtures/streams/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.children/<session-id>.jsonl` with the
  `.settings.json` beside each. A fixture is committed only after `gitleaks detect --no-git` on the
  directory is clean and a reviewer has read it; raw lines may carry tool output.

### S — Walking skeleton

- **Outcome.** Cargo workspace with `crates/observatory-core`, `crates/observatory-cli`,
